body.statement: Dwivedi et al.'s published Assumptions 6--7 permit bounded coordinatewise Lipschitz nonlinear functions of exogenous unit and time factors supported on a compact cube with lower-bounded time-factor density, and their Theorem 4.1 gives the corresponding unit-by-time nearest-neighbor error bound under Assumptions 1, 2, 4, 6, and 7.

source.locator: published pages 2397--2398, Assumptions 6--7, equation (27), and Theorem 4.1
source.verbatim_statement: Assumption 6 gives the nonlinear conditional-mean factorization in equation (27) with bounded coordinatewise Lipschitz functions; Assumption 7 supplies the compact-support and time-factor density conditions.  Theorem 4.1 starts from Assumptions 1, 2, 4, 6, and 7 and gives the corresponding unit-by-time estimator error bound.

attestation.note: Verified directly against the published article text on 2026-09-08, including the regularity assumptions and Theorem 4.1's stated assumption set and unit-by-time conclusion.
